title: GHSL AI-agent index lists SonarCloud token redirection in kpt workflow
ai_system: GitHub Security Lab AI agent (system not named in advisory)
summary: The privileged workflow checks out a fork-controlled sonar.properties and runs SonarScanner with SONAR_TOKEN; an attacker-controlled sonar.host.url can redirect the scanner’s authenticated bootstrap request to an external host.
ai_role: GHSL’s primary AI-agent index lists this advisory as discovered with AI agents, but the item advisory credits the human researcher and does not name an AI system or describe its role. This is index-level AI attribution only; no specific model or independent agent contribution is claimed.
classification_note: The cited sources document the issue and fix but do not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: Fixed in PR #4780 on 2026-09-30. Successful pull-request workflow execution and an available SONAR_TOKEN are prerequisites.

impacts.conditions: An external fork author can cause the privileged SonarCloud analysis workflow to send the repository SONAR_TOKEN to an attacker-selected host. The attacker can exercise that token permissions for SonarCloud permissions and manipulate authenticated analysis.
impacts.exploitation: Exploitation in the wild is not established by the cited description.
